notes.title: Fixed dialogues and health
notes.notes:
We fixed some minor problems with some story dialogues and smaller bugs and increased the bosses health.

Thank you for playing!

Sincerely,
Cat Logic Games team.

notes.title: New patch
notes.notes:
In this new patch we solved the problem with the map background not showing on interiors and fixed the resolution dropdown getting stuck. And also a problem with the second boss in the cemetery area where sometimes he attacked you before the dialogue.

Sincerely,
Cat Logic Games team.

notes.title: NEW VIDEO! Basic controls on The Path To Die
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/M0LH2JIQPmA

In this video, you will learn the basics about the combat system to become a true samurai and not fail your clan in The Path To Die.

We hope this will help the players to understand how the basic controls work on the game with a controller. The attacks are exactly the same with k&m.

If you have any doubt about something please do not hesitate to ask.

Sincerely,
Cat Logic Games Team

notes.title: New Patch with a few fixes.
notes.notes:
In this new patch the problem with the animations by unlocking the framerate has been fixed. Also some minor errors and a problem related to the menu sound have also been fixed.

Thank you for playing!

Sincerely,
Cat Logic Games team.

notes.title: Sharpen your katana, samurai. The time has come.
notes.notes:
[b]The Path To Die will be on sale tomorrow 8th at 9:00am PST.[/b]

Remember that if you are interested you can add it to your wishlist.

Also we want to remember that the game has been designed to be played with gamepad but it can also be played with k&m.

We hope that you all enjoy the samurai experience with our first videogame.

Sincerely,
Cat Logic Games team.
